offering_description.value: Sells branded protein shakes, protein powders, and sports nutrition bars and gels to consumers through retailers, online marketplaces and fitness channels. Makes products through outsourced manufacturers and markets them under its own brands.

primary_products.value: ready-to-drink protein shakes; protein powders; protein bars; energy gels

customer_segment.value: B2C: health-conscious consumers and athletes buying shakes, powders and bars; B2B: grocery, club and mass retailers, and online marketplaces that resell its products

end_markets.value: consumer packaged foods; sports nutrition; health and wellness; fitness

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail and online sales of shakes, powders, bars and gels

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets its own brands, uses outside manufacturers, and sells to retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada are the main markets, sports nutrition products also sold internationally

specialization.value: related lines: protein shakes, protein powders, bars and gels sold to the same nutrition-focused customers

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery, mass, club and drug retailers; online: e-commerce marketplaces and its own websites; direct sales: sales teams selling to large retail accounts; distributors / dealers: specialty and international distributors for sports nutrition products
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; online; direct sales; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food and dietary supplement labeling rules and FTC advertising rules

notes: Geographic split and the exact set of distributors are not fully certain.
